questions.question: What must an end-to-end latency budget include?
options: Feature lookup, queueing, inference, policy, and network time
questions.explanation: The caller experiences the complete path, not just the model kernel.

questions.question: Why should timed-out work be cancelled?
options: Abandoned requests otherwise consume capacity and grow queues
questions.explanation: Continuing useless work can turn a latency incident into sustained overload.

questions.question: What should happen when features violate freshness requirements?
options: Use a declared fallback or abstain
Run the model with misleading inputs
questions.explanation: Feature freshness is part of the tested model contract.

questions.question: Why keep the previous serving version compatible during rollout?
questions.explanation: A rollback works only if the prior artifact and feature contract can still run.
